VBO:0200858.summary: Affectionate once familiar, Mocha was a Maltese–Jack Russell cross whose rescuers said relationships took time to form. They described an active dog who loved playing with younger small dogs, learned new routines quickly and responded to food rewards and commands. The same account noted barking when people tried to leave.
VBO:0200858.shortDescription: Mocha’s rescuers described a lively Maltese–Jack Russell cross, affectionate once familiar and keen on food rewards.
